def is_valid_parenthese(str1):
    """Write a function to verify validity of a string of parentheses."""
    if not isinstance(str1, str):
        return False
    pairs = {")": "(", "]": "[", "}": "{"}
    opening = set(pairs.values())
    stack = []
    for char in str1:
        if char in opening:
            stack.append(char)
        elif char in pairs:
            if not stack or stack[-1] != pairs[char]:
                return False
            stack.pop()
        else:
            return False
    return not stack
